dedupe_keys.name: activity browser life cycle assessment gui

description: Activity Browser is Bernhard Steubing and contributors' graphical application for life-cycle assessment using Brightway. It combines multiple reference flows, impact categories and scenarios with parameter editing, uncertainty analysis and supply-chain exploration. Inputs are inventory databases, process parameters and scenario assumptions; outputs include impact results, contribution analyses, Sankey diagrams and Monte Carlo summaries. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the supplied inventories. Source is free under LGPL-3.0, while external inventory databases retain their own terms. Public installation and getting-started guides support desktop use. A limitation is that the advertised version 3 uses Brightway 2.5 in an open beta, so users must distinguish beta features from their installed release. Activity Browser can compare infrastructure material, energy and waste scenarios. Brightway (platform-brightway-lca) supplies its calculation base. No inventory database or application package was downloaded.
